title: Confirm legal source and convert one third-party adventure into module schema
description: GATED follow-up split from E2 (loreweaver-hlu). The module schema, license metadata, template fork, overlay resolution, and world_query ship now, proven by an original authored sample pack. Converting an actual third-party adventure into the schema is a one-time model-assisted CONTENT task gated on confirming the source is open/public-domain/original/publisher-licensed. Do not start until the legal source is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A specific adventure source is confirmed open/PD/original/publisher-licensed in writing. 2. That adventure is converted into schema-conforming module files validated by validateModulePack. 3. Pack license metadata reflects the confirmed source license.
